instruction: Present men's large shirts that have a minimum 50% discount.

metadata.explanation: Variation 3: Removed the sleeve length filter requirement (any sleeve length acceptable) while keeping size Large and 50% discount. This reduces complexity slightly compared to the original by having 4 filter criteria instead of 5. The evaluator uses custom getter get_macys_url_parse__6e5c341c9d3ff8b7569de2db0f8a4fd6 to parse the URL. The metric check_macys_url_params__6e5c341c9d3ff8b7569de2db0f8a4fd6 verifies: mens_clothing=true, shirts=true, Men_regular_size_t=L, Price_discount_range=50_PERCENT_ off & more.
